description: A system development life cycle (SDLC) that integrates information security and privacy considerations is not managed.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing SDLC documentation, absence of security and privacy integration in development phases, lack of defined security roles in the SDLC, missing risk management integration, inadequate security requirements in design and development, and absence of security testing in the development lifecycle.
